do.name: Roman Baths
do.detail: Walk the torch-lit terraces of the 2000 year old bathing complex over the hot spring, rediscovered and rebuilt by the Victorians.

do.name: Thermae Bath Spa rooftop soak
do.detail: Bathe in Britain's only naturally warm mineral waters, ending in the open-air rooftop pool with the Abbey and hills in view. Over 16s only.

do.name: Royal Crescent and Circus stroll
do.detail: Georgian set pieces a few lanes apart: the sweeping 30 house crescent above its lawn, the circle of townhouses, and No. 1 as a museum.

do.name: Bath Abbey and its tower tour
do.detail: Fan-vaulted gothic abbey beside the springs; the guided tower climb looks straight down on the Roman Baths and across the city roofs.

do.name: River Avon boat trip and canal towpath
do.detail: Cruise or row the Avon below Pulteney Bridge toward Bathampton, or follow the Kennet and Avon canal towpath out past Sydney Gardens.

do.name: Pulteney Bridge and the weir
do.detail: One of a handful of bridges anywhere with shops the whole way across, standing over a horseshoe weir. The boats leave from underneath it and Parade Gardens looks straight at it.

do.name: Bath Skyline circular walk
do.detail: Free waymarked 6 mile National Trust loop through beech woods and wildflower meadows on the rim above the city, minutes from the Abbey.
